Location: MBBS, NC, Orange Co, Route 01, Wade Loop
Observation Details: One Horned Lark singing and walking on a gravel driveway and among the rows of a tobacco field, along Efland-Cedar Grove Rd about 0.5-0.75 miles southwest from the intersection with Rt. 86 north of Hillsborough, NC.  We did not have time to study this bird in detail, but it seemed to NB that it was a fairly bright yellow bird (ssp alpestris?) rather than one of the paler subspecies.    On May 22, 2011, we had 2 Horned Larks at the exact same spot, though at that time the fields were recently plowed and not yet planted.
